author: yummys
body:
Age: 15

Timezone: UTC-07:00

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers? I don't really have any experience, but like most people I have moderated chat on small servers, and I have made my own server, so I kind of know what it's like to be staff on a server, but not on a big server. 


What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating? My biggest weakness is probably me talking a lot. Everyone always thinks I talk a lot. This will affect my moderating, because when someone reports a player and I am talking to someone I would probably want to stay their and talk to them even though it would be my job to go and see what they reported. My biggest strength is being respectful to others. This will affect my moderating, because I like to mini mod on every server, and I enjoy respecting people and treating them the way they should be treated. 


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team? I believe I will help improve the staff team by being on a lot. I spend a lot of time on Avicus, a lot of people always say "the staff is never on" so I want to change that and be on a lot, so I can help the server stay fun and kind and cheater-free.


What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why? The qualities I believe a leader should have are; respecting everyone, listening to everyone's opinion, being a good communicator, and knowing how to get people to listen to them to change the world. I am pretty sure I would consider myself a leader. I mean I could improve on some of those things, and I will as I strive to help the community, but as of now, yes I would consider myself a leader, but I can become a better leader if I practice those skills with the community. 


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator? Some attributes I like to think that distinguish me from other players are; I mini mod a lot, I respect others all the time, I listen to what others have to say, I am kind, and courteous, I also have 2 younger brothers I always have to look after so I am responsible and trustworthy, I never break my promises, and I do as I am told. These are the attributes I think distinguish me from other players. 


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? The skills i believe I should have when I am interacting with the community are; respecting them, listening to what they have to say, helping them with any problem they face me with, and also spending time with them to get to know everyone a little more. I believe I have these qualities, but yes I could improve on them, and I will, I have a goal of trying to get to know new people on our community and interacting with them. 


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?  I could commit about 5 hours on school days and about 10 hours on weekends, but when summer time comes I will be able to spend about 10 hours every day, except Sunday, because I am religious person, so I will not be able to get on Sundays. 



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do? I would get on the sever open my recording software, and start recording this ban evader, then I would ban him when I have collected sufficient information of this player hacking. 



Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do? I would get on the channel and ask the staff member to please stop harassing other players, and to please be respectful, then I would tell an Admin or a Sr Mod to get on and deal with them if they have not stopped harassing other players instead of treating them with respect. 



A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do? I would say that the evidence I gathered has been corrupted and therefore I would have to unban the player, and look if he starts cheating again, and record him when possible. 


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do? I would tell my team mate that was wrong of him to post something that is only allowed to staff members, then i would take a screenshot of him posting that. I would get an Admin or Sr Mod to come deal with the problem and give them the evidence I collected.



One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?  I would just go with the decision even though I did not agree, because the staff is a team and they do what their leader tells them. I have learned that in a team you should just go with what your leader tells you even if you do not full agree, because you trust them, and they are responsible. 



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you? It would mean a lot to me if I became a moderator on Avicus, because I have met a lot of great people and made a lot of friends. I also spend a lot of time on Avicus. I would love to be a moderator so I could punish cheaters and keep the server fun and free of bullies and cheaters. 



How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you? I am very passionate about Avicus, because like i said I spend a lot of time on Avicus and enjoy spending time with the community and helping players with problems they encounter. Avicus is like a home to me because I spend all day on it, I talk to people from this community and become friends with them, honestly if we could live in a virtual world I would chose to live in the Avicus community.



Do you speak any other languages than English? I understand everything in Spanish, and I would say my speaking skills are about 8 or 8.5/10 so I am pretty fluent in Spanish. 



Do you have anything else to add to your application? All I want to add is I would really appreciate being chosen to become a staff member, because this is something I have been dreaming of becoming since I first heard of Avicus. I also want to help the community as much as I can and spend more time to get to know each and every one of them. I hope you guys enjoy reading my application and consider it. Thank you for everything you have done for me and this community. 



                                                                                                                                                                      Sincerely,

                                                                                                                                                                Aaron/LetsCuddle
